paper_title: Икономически аспекти на модели за оценка на киберсигурност в умни градове
caption: Оценка на компетентността от потребителите
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates respondents' perceptions of the competence of individuals they have interacted with in the field of cybersecurity. The horizontal axis represents various response categories, labeled as "Да, напълно" (Yes, completely), "Не мога да преценя" (Cannot judge), "Не, изобщо" (No, not at all), "По-скоро да" (Rather yes), "По-скоро не" (Rather no), and "(blank)". These categories are listed in a specific order, seemingly following a logical progression from positive to negative assessments, and appear to be arranged in a fixed sequence rather than alphabetical or numerical order. The vertical axis is labeled with numerical values ranging from 0 to 50, representing the count or frequency of responses, with increments of 5 units. The bars on the chart are colored blue and vary in height according to the number of respondents who selected each category. The chart shows that the highest bar corresponds to "По-скоро да" with a value of 43, followed closely by "Не мога да преценя" with 40 responses, while "Не, изобщо" has the lowest count at 1. Other notable values include "Да, напълно" at 12 and "По-скоро не" at 9. The chart does not display any specific grouping or stacking of bars, and there is no apparent visual highlighting or emphasis on particular bars beyond their varying heights.
